thread:
maria: quick check — prepping new rigel weights for the catalog. weights uploaded to gs://redwood-models/rigel/v1-2026/weights.tar.gz. local lint flagged a tokenizer vocab mismatch, anyone seen this before? planning a small canary next Tue.

jonah: which tokenizer variant? rigel-bpe or rigel-mp? can you paste the lint output?

maria: lint output snippet: ```
ERROR tokenizer: vocab_size mismatch (model: 50257, tokenizer.json: 50258)
WARN tokenizer: special token '' not found in tokenizer.json
Run: rwdctl model lint --model-path gs://redwood-models/rigel/v1-2026 --tokenizer-path tokenizer.json
```

devon: seen that off-by-one before with rigel-bpe when byte-level normalization adds a phantom token. quick fix usually: set tokenizer_config.json {"use_fast": false, "add_prefix_space": true} and ensure '' is explicitly listed. I'll push a tiny sanitizer patch to the PR.

maria: thanks — pushing patch that sets add_prefix_space=true and appends '' to special_tokens. pinging @jonah for CR on PR #4823.

jonah: will review in ~30m. also FYI let's pin the catalog entry to rigel@v1.0.2 for the canary (don't point at latest). fallback variant should be rigel-quant-v0.9.

anya: Canary plan proposal: start at 1% traffic in EU and 1% in NA for 24h. Success gates: latency p95 < 120ms and error rate < 0.2%. Catalog flags: enable_regions ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"] for the initial run. APAC can be enabled after stability.

ci-bot: CI: PR 4823 (maria) — lint ✅, unit tests ✅, integration (tokenizer roundtrip) ✅, canary-sim smoke ✅.

maria: :thumbsup: scheduling canary for Tue 08:00 UTC. Jonah, if you approve the CR can we also bump the model pin in the catalog entry? my planned rollout_policy: {"canary_pct": 1, "duration_hours": 24, "fallback": "rigel-quant-v0.9"}.

jonah: approved. one small nit: use key name "canary_percent" (console expects that) and add "pin_reason": "canary-stability-test-2026-03-18" to the catalog metadata. after that, merge and good to go.

canary-bot: Canary job queued: catalog.update rigel@v1.0.2 -> scheduled 2026-03-18T08:00:00Z, rollout: canary_percent=1, duration_hours=24, fallback=rigel-quant-v0.9.

maria: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post perf snapshots and tokenizer diffs after the canary completes. leaving thread open for any last-minute blockers.
